children: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has made an $11.6 billion deal with cloud infrastructure firm Akamai for its computing services for the next seven years, Akamai announced, with an option to expand the deal by another $9 billion if more compute is needed.
Akamai stock rose nearly 18% in after-hours trading on the news.
This is breaking news. Check back for updates.
